name: ai.privos.mcp-app-demo-can-run
title: PrivOS Demo MCP App Can Run
description: HR Mini App for PrivOS: recruitment pipeline with AI CV scoring, scored-CV kanban, JD editor, employee lifecycle, payroll, drafting bot and email history.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so every HR tab loads the right room’s data.
Read candidate, employee and email-history lists of this room (mcpapp.lists.getAll/getItems/get/searchItems).
Create lists, fields and items for scored CVs, employee profiles and email history; move kanban cards between stages.
Read JD, CV, template and company files stored in the room (mcpapp.files.getByChannel/get/search/getContent, mcpapp.folders.*).
Upload scoring skills, JDs, generated documents and payroll exports; rename and delete processed CVs (app.uploadFile, mcpapp.files.update/delete).
Read payroll records of this room through the app’s hrm.payroll.query tool (mcpapp.db.query with the installation-bot credential, pinned to the verified caller room).
Create, update and soft-delete payroll records through hrm.payroll.create/update/delete (mcpapp.db.create/update/delete).
Read the payroll collection schema (mcpapp.db.getSchema) when diagnosing a room.
Register the room-scoped payroll collection once per room (mcpapp.db.registerCollection).
Poll AI generation results for CV scoring and the company summary (ai-messages.list).
permissions.degradedBehavior: CV scoring and the Company home summary cannot read AI results; manual scoring remains available.

permissions.reason: Start AI generation for CV scoring and the company summary (ai-messages.send / ai-messages.startGeneration).
permissions.degradedBehavior: AI scoring and the AI company summary are disabled; every other tab keeps working.

dataPolicy.retention: App data is retained until the installation or corresponding HR records are deleted.

tools.name: hr_management_dashboard
tools.title: PrivOS Demo MCP App
tools.description: Open the HR Mini App dashboard.

tools.name: hr_whoami
tools.title: Who am I (verified)
tools.description: Return the user identity authenticated by the Hub's body-bound private dispatch assertion.

tools.name: hr_bulk_export
tools.title: Bulk export HR records
tools.description: Export records in bulk. Requires the Pro tier.

tools.name: hr_agent_bot_credential_check
tools.title: Validate agent bot credential
tools.description: Confirm this app's configured agent bot credential authenticates against the Hub.

tools.name: hrm.payroll.query
tools.title: Query payroll records
tools.description: List payroll records of the room the verified caller is in. Requires a Hub-verified actor.

tools.name: hrm.payroll.create
tools.title: Create payroll record
tools.description: Create one payroll record in the verified caller room.

tools.name: hrm.payroll.update
tools.title: Update payroll record
tools.description: Update one payroll record by id in the verified caller room.

tools.name: hrm.payroll.delete
tools.title: Delete payroll record
tools.description: Soft-delete one payroll record by id in the verified caller room.

tools.name: hrm.mail.send
tools.title: Send HR email
tools.description: Send one email through the HR relay and record it in the room email history. Requires a Hub-verified actor.

tools.name: hrm.mail.retry
tools.title: Retry a failed HR email
tools.description: Re-send a failed email from the room history using its stored recipient and content.
